description: Elixir accepts fn -> a; b end (and fn x -> a; b end) with the semicolon separating two expressions of the body. fz refuses it with parse/expected-token ... Semi. Found while writing a spawned-process probe for fz-sc8.61; rewritten with newlines as a workaround in the probe only. Deviation from Elixir surface syntax; fix in the parser's block-body rule wherever ; is already accepted between expressions.
title: fn -> a; b end parses: a semicolon separates expressions in a one-line anonymous function body
